info.title: API.SH: Books
info.description: The Books API from API.SH: public Books data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An author by Open Library id or name: names, birth and death dates, biography, photos, links, identifiers (Wikidata, VIAF, ISNI...), work count and works (title, first publish date, subjects, cover). `list=true` with `q` lists matching authors instead.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/books-author

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Open Library author id, e.g. OL34184A.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches Open Library's 20M+ books by keywords, title, author, subject, publisher, ISBN, person, place or time period, with language, first-publication-year, full-text and e-book access filters: work id, title, authors, first publish year, edition count, cover, ISBNs, languages, subjects, publishers, median pages, rating, want-to-read and read counts, e-book access. Sort by relevance, newest, oldest, rating, editions, title or random. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/books-search

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language (3-letter MARC code: eng, fre, spa, ger...).

parameters.name: person
parameters.description: Person the book is about or features, e.g. sherlock holmes.

parameters.name: place
parameters.description: Place the book is about or set in, e.g. london.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time period the book is about, e.g. 19th century.

parameters.name: has_fulltext
parameters.description: true: books with a readable or borrowable digital copy; false: without.

parameters.name: ebook_access
parameters.description: Minimum e-book access: public (free to read), borrowable (public or borrowable) or printdisabled (any digital copy).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

publishers: Công ty văn hóa & truyền thông Nhã Nam

get.description:
Books on a subject (most-edited first): work id, title, authors, first publish year, edition count, cover; with the subject's work count and, on page 1, its top related authors, subjects and publishers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/books-subject

parameters.name: subject

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
